notes: Naya: Google Drive ab Auto Post ka source hai. Auto Post page par apne Drive folder ka link dein — public sharing ("Anyone with the link") wala — aur us ke liye Facebook Page chunein; app wahan se videos utha kar naam ki tarteeb se, ek video har muqarrar time par, aap ke Page par schedule par post karega jab haath wali queue khali ho. Har video sirf ek dafa post hogi. "Abhi check karo" se foran check aur agli video ki post bhi ho jati hai. Is version mein sirf public folders chalte hain — private Drive ke liye Google ki apni verification chahiye, wo alag step hai.
